diffs.diff: pin count: part has 5 (VDD GND SDA SCL SEL), datasheet reading has 7 (VDD GND SDA SCL SEL NC NC)
diffs.evidence: Sensirion SFA30 datasheet, section 2.5 Pin Assignment, Table 8: the Molex Micro-Lock Plus 7-circuit connector has pins 1 VDD, 2 GND, 3 RX/SDA, 4 TX/SCL, 5 SEL, '6 NC Do not connect', '7 NC Do not connect'. The second reading counts all 7 connector positions; the model exposes the 5 functional pins and its description explicitly states 'pins 6 and 7 are NC and left unwired'. Signal names and order of pins 1-5 match exactly, so omitting the two do-not-connect pins is correct and safe.
